business_problem: Kingdee International Software Group (Kingdee), a global provider of enterprise management and cloud enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions, serves millions of businesses worldwide in digital transformation.
solution_summary: Kingdee International Software Group (Kingdee), a global provider of enterprise management and cloud enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions, serves millions of businesses worldwide in digital transformation. To meet the evolving demands of ERP systems, Kingdee developed two generative AI solutions powered by Amazon Bedrock : an intelligent ticketing system and a metrics analysis tool. Amazon Bedrock provided a selection of foundational models (FMs), customization options, and application integration features, giving Kingdee access to mainstream models for its global operations while maintaining enterprise-level security. Kingdee also implemented Amazon Bedrock Agents to develop generative AI applications capable of executing complex tasks across company systems and data sources.
